title: Exceptional performance
text: It was truly an extraordinary experience! My husband and I were thoroughly captivated by their remarkable performance. The singing and dancing were so powerful and captivating. We were pleasantly surprised by the intimacy of the stage. We found ourselves right in front of the small stage. The eight members of the performers are quite exceptional. This is a cultural shock and a learning experience for me in Barcelona.
